title: Umeda Sky Building
geometryBasis: Named pair of mapped towers, level-specific parts, circular opening and three cleared photographs from the Qualla story.
sectionBasis: 173 m linked roof, stepped 40-storey reflective towers, open lower plaza and paired approximately 40 m escalators.
limitations: The mapped tower parts and roof aperture control plan geometry. The 173 m height and escalator span come from the owner. Heights of individual terrace levels, curtain wall modules and supporting details are estimates.

The 2007 photograph supplies the view through the permanent crown and escalator arrangement. The two April 2011 photos guide cladding and lower supports. Temporary access rigs and neighboring development are outside the model scope.
The source terrain is unchanged and the plaza connections are approximate.
